_about: SABOTAGE (a gate-failed run leaves rows behind): a vendor page that writes one of EVERY kind — a fact with its evidence, a source_doc and a doc_parts link, a upc alias, an image assignment, an image candidate, a relation, a lifecycle row and a part_source_check. Paired with the cdw file in this directory, whose missing adapter suite fails the gate. Until 4 Sep 2026 all of those except the fact were committed before the gate was even computed, and rollbackRun removed only facts/evidence/conflicts — so the catalogue kept an alias, a picture and a 'we looked' check from a run nobody was allowed to trust. Every table is asserted at zero for this run's id.
